title: Add Page Numbers to PDF – Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Add page numbers to a PDF in your browser: pick where they go and the first number, then download. Free, no sign-up, and your file is never uploaded.
heading: Add Page Numbers to PDF
subtitle: Number every page of a PDF at the top or bottom, starting from any number, in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: The numbers are drawn on your PDF by your own browser. The file is never sent to a server.

features.title: Free with no limits
features.text: No account, no watermark and no cap on pages or files.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, numbering keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Pick the position and first number
steps.text: Choose where the numbers go (top or bottom; left, centre or right) and the number of the first page.

steps.title: Add numbers and download
steps.text: Click Add page numbers, then download the numbered PDF. Nothing leaves your device.

limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be numbered; remove the password first.
Every page gets a number; leaving out a cover page isn't offered yet.
Numbers use Western digits (1, 2, 3) in a plain font, and are drawn over anything already in that corner of the page.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your PDF is read and numbered by your browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it yourself: open your browser's network panel and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Where can the page numbers go?
faq.answer: At the top or the bottom of each page, on the left, in the centre or on the right.

faq.question: Can I start from a number other than 1?
faq.answer: Yes. Type the number of the first page, for example 5 when the PDF continues another document.

faq.question: Can I number a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then add the numbers.

faq.question: Does the rest of my PDF change?
faq.answer: No. Only the numbers are added; text, images and links stay as they were.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
